title: Meet the Capacitor Family
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Beginning electronics and capacitor selection
description: An interactive three-column infographic comparing ceramic, electrolytic, and tantalum capacitors.

learningObjectives: Explain how polarity, capacitance range, and construction make common capacitor types suitable for different uses.

keyQuestions: How does polarity affect capacitor selection?
Why are different capacitor constructions suited to different jobs?
commonMisconceptions: A larger capacitance value is always the best choice.
